defs.def: that can be seen 看得见的；可见的

ex.s: That is why when the stars are out, they are visible, but when the lights are out, they are invisible.
ex.t: 这就是为什么当星星出来时，它们可以看到，但当灯熄灭时，它们就看不到了。

ex.s: Here, there was no visible light from the Sun or from the Earth Engines.
ex.t: 在这里，既没有来自太阳也没有来自地球发动机的可见光。

ex.s: At the far side of the valley, an ancient Sami cottage is visible.
ex.t: 在山谷的远处，可以看到一间古老的萨米小屋。

ex.s: The Aboriginal population might be small, but its influence is still visible.
ex.t: 原住民人口或许不多，但其影响依然可见。

ex.s: This vast dish also has the ability to explore regions of space billions of light years away, right at the edge of the visible universe.
ex.t: 这个巨大的菜肴还能够探索数十亿光年外的空间区域, 就在可见宇宙的边缘.

defs.def: that is obvious enough to be noticed 明显的；能注意到的
